name: indexer-diff
description: Two jars' extra indexers on one chain (a miner, X on this role's jar, Y on the other's, both with extraIndex): their /blockchain answers (every box and transaction by global index, per-address balance, transaction and box ids, unspent boxes, token info) compared field by field at settled points after payments and a token issue, after a restart of Y, and after Y rolls back a losing branch. A positive control must show DIFF or the run is INCONCLUSIVE. Written for ergoplatform/ergo#2640 (indexer recovery in the 6.0.8 candidate).
